svg.title: All Agent in One Platform / 全Agents统一接入
svg.desc: Four built-in Agents and every other Agent in the current official ACP Registry connect through animated routes to the VibeX IAP core, which contains the Agent Client Protocol layer and scheduler. 四个内置 Agent 与当前官方 ACP 注册表中的其他 Agent 通过动态线路接入由 ACP 和调度器组成的 VibeX IAP 中心内核。
